items.headline: European Digital Infrastructure Consortium launches today to strengthen digital sovereignty in education
items.summary: European Digital Infrastructure Consortium launches today to strengthen digital sovereignty in education Anonymous (not verified) Fri, 11/20/2026 - 11:30 Today, the European Commission and eight Member States are launching the European Digital Infrastructure Consortium on Education (EDU-EDIC) to pool resources and develop shared, secure and interoperable digital infrastructure and services for education.

items.headline: Hackers Compromise 24 Check Point Management Servers in Suspected AI-Driven Attack Campaign
items.summary: An unknown threat actor has been using artificial intelligence (AI)-driven offensive tooling in a campaign targeting Check Point Security Management servers, impacting 22 distinct organizations across the world. The intrusion activity, tracked by GreyNoise under the moniker GreyNoise Threat 13 (GT13), is assessed to have targeted organizations in the financial services, energy, government.
